Name: ai-route-arrival
Commands:
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight power to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight speed to 10
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight precision to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight behavior to true
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to true
wait 60
print "EC_PASS"

Name: ai-route-stop-resume
Commands:
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight power to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight speed to 10
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight precision to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight behavior to true
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to true
wait 6
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to false
wait 12
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to true
wait 60
print "EC_PASS"

Name: ai-threat-retreat
Commands:
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight power to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight speed to 10
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight precision to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight behavior to true
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive behavior to true
wait 12
if "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive fleeing
  print "EC_FAIL: defensive fled before the request"
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive flee to true
wait 60
print "EC_PASS"

assign retreatPoint to "EC Test PB" terminal position + 0:0:-150
set "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive behavior to true
wait 12
if not "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive target
  print "EC_FAIL: offensive did not detect target"
set "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive behavior to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight speed to 10
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight precision to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight behavior to true
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive behavior to true
wait 12
if not "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive target
  print "EC_FAIL: defensive did not detect target"
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive target position to retreatPoint
if "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive target position != retreatPoint
  print "EC_FAIL: retreat override readback"
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive flee to true
wait 60
print "EC_PASS"
Name: ai-detection-and-retarget
ai-repeat-route-lifecycle
Commands:
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight speed to 10
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight precision to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight behavior to true
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder repeat path to true
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to true
wait 140
if not "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder playing
  print "EC_FAIL: looping route stopped"
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder repeat path to false
wait 90
if "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder playing
  print "EC_FAIL: route did not finish after repeat disabled"
print "EC_PASS"

Name: ai-target-loss
Commands:
set "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive behavior to true
wait 12
if not "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive target
  print "EC_FAIL: offensive acquisition"
set "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive behavior to false
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive behavior to true
wait 12
if not "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive target
  print "EC_FAIL: defensive acquisition"
wait 20
if "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive target
  print "EC_FAIL: defensive stale target"
set "EC Drone Defensive" ai defensive behavior to false
set "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive behavior to true
wait 12
if "EC Drone Offensive" ai offensive target
  print "EC_FAIL: offensive stale target"
print "EC_PASS"
